title: Convert ASCII diagrams in docs to Mermaid
description:
Five adopter-facing docs draw diagrams as ASCII art; the content standards require Mermaid for all diagrams, and ASCII-art diagrams are forbidden in docs. Convert each diagram while directory listings and verbatim CLI output stay plain text.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every authored diagram in docs/ is a fenced Mermaid block conveying the same relationships as the ASCII art it replaces
- [hard] REQ-02: Directory listings and verbatim CLI output remain plain text
- [hard] REQ-03: docs/ is free of authored box-drawing and arrow-art diagrams

## Notes

Affected diagrams: docs/concepts/core-model.md (labels-vs-DAG boxes), docs/concepts/design-philosophy.md (two boxed layer diagrams), docs/how-to/dependency-management.md (boxed dependency illustration), docs/tutorials/parallel-work-worktrees.md (worktree control-plane arrows), docs/reference/labels.md (membership-vs-blocking arrow art).
